description: Ministry of Public Service, Provincial Council and Local Government - 6th Amendment of Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Architects Service
reasoning: This gazette contains amendments to the Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Architects Service, detailing recruitment procedures, examination schemes, and qualification requirements. It is issued by the Public Service Commission and deals specifically with public service recruitment and examination matters, which falls under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) rather than government structure/personnel changes.
